model.maya_recipe: {"name":"Maya-S v2","note":"IQ2_XXS gate/up (error-feedback rounding);down one step up everywhere - IQ3_XXS in the first and last four MoE layers, IQ2_S in the rest;Q6_K attention, shared experts and dense layers;Maya's calibration and per-expert imatrix;the NextN draft block (Q2_K/Q3_K experts)","rules":[{"match":"^blk\\.45\\.ffn_(gate|up)_exps","type":"Q2_K"},{"match":"^blk\\.45\\.ffn_down_exps","type":"Q3_K"},{"match":"ffn_(gate|up)_exps","type":"IQ2_XXS"},{"match":"^blk\\.([3-6]|4[1-4])\\.ffn_down_exps","type":"IQ3_XXS"},{"match":"ffn_down_exps","type":"IQ2_S"},{"match":"ffn_gate_inp|exp_probs_b|hc_|indexer_compressor_ape","type":"F32"},{"match":"ssm_(beta|f_a|f_b|g_a|g_b)|indexer","type":"Q8_0"}],"default":"Q6_K"}
model.quant: experts IQ2_XXS gate/up + IQ3_XXS down; dense/attention Q6_K + q8_0 + f32; NextN draft IQ2_S/IQ3_XS; drafter Q4_K_M
